newsitem.title: GERMANY: German June unemployment rises to 4.37 million.
newsitem.headline: German June unemployment rises to 4.37 million.

text.p: German unemployment rose to a seasonally adjusted 4.374 million in June, the Federal Labour Office said on Tuesday.
The unemployment rate, which is based on unadjusted data, fell to 11.0 percent, compared with 11.1 percent in May.

"We are seeing signs of stability particularly in west Germany. Economic improvements are progressing but there is still no turnaround on the jobs market," Bernhard Jagoda, Federal Labour Office president said.
In western Germany, the number of people out of work on a seasonally adjusted basis fell to 3.041 million in June down 1,000 on the previous month.
Eastern Germany added 12,000 to unemployment rolls, with the total number of jobless rising to 1.333 million.
On an unadjusted basis, the number of Germans out of work fell to 4.222 million in June from 4.256 million in the previous month.
